sourceFile: 31. BRS-161014 Report TEST new Main 2 Jig V10 & V11_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid source rows but needs regrouping before use because function comparisons mix dates/machines and omit the proper 9/19 baseline.
issues: 9/19 function pairs use 9/18 normal row instead of 9/19 normal row.
Subgroup keys date, machine, jig version, and guide jig are not preserved.
V10 and V11 effects are merged too broadly under one changed factor.
Measurement outcome appears to be parsed from defect columns, not true dimensions.
Change domain includes unsupported categories such as coating.
correctionPlan: Rebuild function comparisons by same date and machine note.
Use 18.9!37 as the 9/19 normal baseline for 18.9!33 and 18.9!35.
Split or clearly subgroup V10, V11, and V10 with VP guide V13 conditions.
Remove the spurious measurement outcome unless dimension rows contain comparable data.
Limit change domain to jig/equipment/process condition supported by cited rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient because grouping and baseline pairing are wrong.
